mapper.select: SELECT session_id, tenant_id, principal_id, principal_type, display_name, status, active_run_id, active_run_version, active_dispatch_key, created_at, last_activity_at, revision FROM sdk_conversation WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sdk_conversation SET active_dispatch_key = #{dispatchKey}, last_activity_at = #{at}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND active_run_id IS NULL AND active_dispatch_key IS NULL

UPDATE sdk_conversation SET active_run_id = #{runId}, active_run_version = #{runVersion}, active_dispatch_key = NULL, last_activity_at = #{at}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND active_dispatch_key = #{dispatchKey} AND active_run_id IS NULL
